documents.title: Annoucement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Intimation To The Holders Of Physical Shares To Furnish KYC Details

analysis.summary: Ador Welding reported annual sales of approximately INR 1,135 crores with a standalone EBITDA margin of 12%. Management highlighted the recovery of INR 14 crores from the Kuwait project and the near completion of the Uran project, which is 96% to 97% complete. The company is realigning its Flares and Process Equipment division into the welding segment and focusing on high-end automation through partnerships like Miller. Future growth strategies include a focus on shipbuilding, renewables, and targeted technology-driven acquisitions.

guidance.claim: The company aims for a 100 to 200 basis points improvement in margins over the coming periods.
guidance.quote: So I think on a similar trajectory, you can see that happen, for another 100, 200 basis points going forward over the coming periods.

guidance.claim: Management is following the principle of reaching a turnover of INR 2,000 crores by FY29.
guidance.quote: We are still following the principle of doing that, but the main principle that drives that is to triple our earnings over that much period of time.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margin improvements to occur over the next few quarters.
guidance.quote: But surely over the next few quarters, you will see EBITDA margin improvements happening.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observes demand through the last few weeks has been good despite Middle East tensions.
demand_outlook.quote: Hopefully that situation will calm down, but we have seen demand through the last few weeks even be good.

demand_outlook.claim: Shipbuilding is a big focus area due to the large quantum of welding required.
demand_outlook.quote: The quantum of welding in shipbuilding is very large. So it is a definitely focus area, we spend a lot of time, effort, and put a lot of resources behind it.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for automation is increasing across SMEs and top-tier companies due to skilled manpower availability.
demand_outlook.quote: I think across the world, across India, we are seeing companies, not only A-class companies, you are seeing B, C, SMEs, all of that look at automation a lot more seriously because of availability of skilled manpower.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the coming year is expected to be in the region of INR 30 crores to INR 35 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capex is generally in the region of approximately INR30 crores-INR35 crores for the coming year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company may spend up to INR 40 crores on capex each year over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: So we expect INR30 crores- INR35 crores, even it could stretch it out to INR40 maybe at the most over the next two years, each year.

capex_expansion.claim: Doubling volume over five to seven years would require approximately INR 100 crores to INR 150 crores in plant and machinery capex.
capex_expansion.quote: I will say anywhere in the region of INR100 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding two to three new lines for this year and next year.
capex_expansion.quote: And this year we will have two-three lines that are coming that are new that are for this year and next year.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone gross margins for the year were 38%, representing an increase of about 250 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For the year standalone, revenue is up about 2%, gross margins at 38%, up about 250 bps.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a standalone EBITDA margin of 12% for the year.
Q4 EBITDA increased by 200 basis points to approximately INR 38 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA clocked in at approximately INR38 crores, an increase of 200 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Management believes there is room for further internal margin improvements.
margins_costs.quote: I have been talking about how Ador within itself has the ability to improve its own margins, and we have been working towards that. And there is still a little bit of room left.

orders_capacity.claim: Welding capacity utilization is estimated at approximately 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are anywhere -- welding has a lot of different types of lines in consumables as well as in equipment, but I would say a fair estimate is anywhere in the region of approximately 70%.

orders_capacity.claim: Some specific production lines are currently operating at 90% to 95% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: There are some lines that currently operate at 90%-95% for which we need to undertake capex, some new technologies we need to invest for as well, but yes, pretty much along that.

orders_capacity.claim: The business operates on a distribution system with 80% to 85% of sales, resulting in quick rotating cycles rather than long order books.
orders_capacity.quote: We actually, you know, our business operates on a -- 80% to 85% of our sales is on a distribution system.

capital_allocation.claim: Ador is open to targeted acquisitions, particularly those driven by technology.
capital_allocation.quote: We are open to acquisitions, but our acquisitions are a little more targeted now.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on capital employed is approximately 23%.
capital_allocation.quote: Return on capital employed is approximately on the operational EBITDA at approximately 12%, and return on capital employed is approximately 23%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain shocks and lack of clarity pose challenges for planning.
risks_headwinds.quote: But supply chain shocks are just the way things are at the moment, you know, lack of clarity for many planning purposes.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces an income tax demand of approximately INR 14 crores which it has appealed.
risks_headwinds.quote: So income tax matter, we have filed our appeal last week only and we don't see any merit, means that the department will succeed in that.

risks_headwinds.claim: BIS hearings are closed but the process continues in magistrate court with a date in June-July.
risks_headwinds.quote: So the BIS hearings, most of it is closed, but it still got to go back to magistrate court, which we have been given a date sometime in June-July.
